items.exampleEn: There's some chocolate on your cheek.
items.exampleZh: 你的臉頰上沾到巧克力了。

items.exampleEn: He looked ill after the long trip.
items.exampleZh: 長途旅行之後，他看起來病懨懨的。

items.exampleEn: The psychologist listened to the students carefully.
items.exampleZh: 那位心理師仔細聽學生們說話。

items.exampleEn: The baby has ten small toes.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶有十隻小小的腳趾。

items.exampleEn: Bright light can harm your eyes.
I always sweat when I am nervous.
Many players get injured every year.
items.exampleZh: 每年都有很多球員受傷。

items.sentenceEn: Be careful, or you will injure your back.
items.sentenceZh: 小心點，不然你會傷到背。

items.audioEn: It was so hot that everyone was sweating.
items.audioZh: 天氣熱到每個人都在流汗。

items.sentenceEn: The cold wind made my cheeks red.
items.sentenceZh: 冷風把我的臉頰吹得紅紅的。

items.sentenceEn: Plastic bags can harm sea animals.
items.sentenceZh: 塑膠袋會傷害海洋動物。

items.stemEn: She stayed home because she was ____.
items.stemZh: 她待在家裡，因為她生病了。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday was very hot, but Tom went running anyway. After an hour, he was sweating a lot, and his cheeks were red. Then he fell and hit his toe on a stone. He didn't injure it badly, but he walked home slowly. "Running is good for me physically," he said, "but next time I'll run in the evening."
items.passageZh: 上週六天氣很熱，但 Tom 還是去跑步。一個小時後，他滿身大汗，臉頰也紅通通的。接著他跌了一跤，腳趾撞到一塊石頭。傷得不嚴重，但他是慢慢走回家的。他說：「跑步對我的身體很好，不過下次我要傍晚再跑。」

questions.questionZh: Tom 跑步時發生了什麼事？
options: 跑到一半，鞋子突然壞掉了
在不熟悉的小路上迷路了

rubricZh: 可數名詞前加 a（例如 a psychologist）

items.instructionZh: 用 ill 造一個句子，說說某人生病的時候。
referenceEn: I was ill last weekend, so I stayed in bed.
My brother is ill today, so he can't go to school.
rubricZh: ill 是形容詞「生病的」，可放在 be 動詞或 feel、get 等動詞後（例如 was ill、felt ill、got ill）
可用 so 帶出結果（例如 so I stayed in bed）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「ill 放在 be 動詞後（例如 was ill、is ill）」寫死句型位置：I felt ill、She got ill、He became ill 也正確；建議改「ill 當形容詞表示生病（例如 was ill、felt ill）」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "ill 是形容詞「生病的」，可放在 be 動詞或 feel、get 等動詞後（例如 was ill、felt ill、got ill）"（原 "ill 放在 be 動詞後，表示「生病的」（例如 was ill、is ill）"）；放寬位置（第③關 FIX 同）
